Dois roteadores IOL e dois switches IOL-: Two IOL routers and two IOL-L2 switches in a ring (r1 — sw1 = sw2 — r2 — r1), with 4 ports each and a serial console. IOL runs the .bin directly on the host, without KVM and with little memory: good for OSPF, STP, EtherChannel and VLANs. Swap cables in Cables, without restarting. Needs the cisco-iol and cisco-iol-l2 images (Settings › General › VM images) on a Linux x86_64 host.
Lab IOL com clientes (containers nos cab: IOL lab with clients (containers on cables)
Um roteador IOL entre duas redes, cada u: An IOL router between two networks, each with an Alpine container as a client plugged by cable (eth1). Configure on r1 the interfaces e0/0 (10.0.1.1/24) and e0/1 (10.0.2.1/24) and test the ping from cli1 to cli2. Swap cables in Cables, without restarting. Needs the cisco-iol image on a Linux x86_64 host.
Um 7200 e um 3725 emulados pelo Dynamips: A 7200 and a 3725 emulated by Dynamips, linked to each other and to an IOL router (r7200 f0/0 — r3725 f0/0; r7200 f1/0 — iol e0/0). Good for studying classic IOS (OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, NAT) alongside IOL. Runs on Linux or Mac with dynamips installed; IOL needs Linux x86_64. After it comes up, compute each router's idle-PC in Manage. Needs the images cisco-c7200, cisco-c3725 and cisco-iol (Settings › General › VM images).
